why: `paintSettingsControls` has been the single writer of the settings display since issue #532, so a constant here is the whole display: a returning player who chose `Low` opens Settings on `High` while their matches correctly run low, and the next tap moves them to `Medium` rather than to what the button claims. The render obeys the store throughout, which is what makes it silent -- the lie is only in the control that edits it.
